capabilities: Fetch unread emails from an IMAP mailbox
Convert HTML email bodies to Markdown with frontmatter
Save attachments and inline images into the vault
Sync automatically on a configurable interval or manually
Mark imported emails as read on the server
extras: Desktop only because it needs Node.js APIs for IMAP; warns that the IMAP password is stored in plaintext in data.json and recommends app-specific passwords. Installation is via BRAT or manual file copy.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull emails from an IMAP mailbox into a vault as Markdown files with attachments.
summary: IMAP email importer that fetches unread emails from a mailbox and saves them as Markdown notes with YAML frontmatter and local attachments.
